name: yuryalencar-ai-skills
description: Claude Code skills by Yury Alencar Lima — reusable procedures and domain expertise, installable anywhere.

plugins.name: paper-writing-style
plugins.description: House style rules for scientific paper writing in English, distilled from Zucolotto's scientific writing course.

plugins.name: create-abstract
plugins.description: Write a scientific paper abstract in LaTeX following the six-part model, interviewing you for what is missing.

plugins.name: review-abstract
plugins.description: Review an abstract from a writing perspective, labelling every sentence with the model part it implements.

plugins.name: update-abstract
plugins.description: Move an existing abstract forward: reconcile it with a changed manuscript, apply suggested changes, or resume a half-written draft.

plugins.name: create-introduction
plugins.description: Write a paper introduction in LaTeX on the four-movement model, with the general-to-specific funnel and the three citation classes.

plugins.name: review-introduction
plugins.description: Review an introduction: label each movement, trace the funnel, audit citations by class and year, report style defects.

plugins.name: update-introduction
plugins.description: Move an existing introduction forward: reconcile with a changed paper, apply suggested changes, or resume a half-written draft.

plugins.name: create-results-discussion
plugins.description: Write a results and discussion section in LaTeX, one four-class block per figure, with topic sentences and self-contained captions.

plugins.name: review-results-discussion
plugins.description: Review a results and discussion section: matrix of result blocks against the four information classes, plus topic sentences, captions and style.

plugins.name: update-results-discussion
plugins.description: Integrate new or revised data, apply reviewer suggestions, or resume a stalled results and discussion draft.

plugins.name: create-conclusions
plugins.description: Write a conclusions section in LaTeX on the inverse funnel, opening on the principal result and widening to what the field gains.

plugins.name: review-conclusions
plugins.description: Review a conclusions section: three movements, reverse funnel trace, text copied from the results, consistency across the paper.

plugins.name: update-conclusions
plugins.description: Check each conclusion still follows from the evidence, apply suggested changes, or finish an unfinished section.
